facts.fact: 周六 homecoming 舞会之夜，两人下午先去 Jim 家；Jim 传话：无症状正常，有人几天后突然发作如 tidal wave
facts.anchor: Sometimes, he said, it took subjects a few days to start feeling the effects. That for some, symptoms came on slow and steady from the moment of transmission, but for others it could hit suddenly days later, like a tidal wave.

facts.fact: Jim 小屋搬空：家具壁纸海报全不见、地下室数百盘 VHS 全消失
facts.anchor: Not just of people, but of furniture, wallpaper, any decoration or indication that anyone had ever occupied the place.

facts.fact: 所有照片的眼睛被挖掉；Erin 的毕业照在正中央；墙上写 TELL THEM JIM SAYS HELLO
facts.anchor: The eyes on all the faces had been removed from the photos. Cut out in two tiny holes like a little mouse had dug through them.

facts.fact: Erin 突然发作：静电贯穿身体、倒地在门廊
facts.anchor: She felt her body convulse and electricity jolt through her, as though she’d just shoved her tongue into a wall socket.

facts.fact: Erin 在地下室醒来；梦见自己是 Lil' Angus 又变回想当宇航员的幼年自己
facts.anchor: In her dream, she’d been Lil’ Angus from Short Stack, and then she’d been herself but younger.

facts.fact: Erin 看穿 David："You don't love me. You want to be me."——想借她而活
facts.anchor: “You don’t love me,” Erin said suddenly. “You want to be me.”

facts.fact: Erin 主动与 David 发生关系、掐他脖子宣泄（"you want to watch me, because I'm your little TV show"）
facts.anchor: “You want to watch me, because I’m your little TV show,” Erin said.

facts.fact: David 睡后 Erin 喝光一升 Tito's、发现 chaperones 已在社区上空；打电话问父亲"Why did you rape me?"再自证父亲没做过
